video.decoding_capability: 64 CH real-time display, up to 1920 fps@D1; local display 12 MP (30fps), 8.3 MP (120fps), 1080p (480fps), 720P (960fps), D1 (1560fps)

power.supply: AC 100 to 240 V, ATX 520 W (53 V/360 W for PoE; 12 V/160 W for HDD/system)

features: 1 x 2.5-inch SATA interface in addition to the 8 hot-swappable 3.5-inch bays
N + M failover with fallback (with alternative firmware)
Video analytics events from cameras as recording trigger
Remote users: 4 for playback; unlimited for live unicast and multicast
Up to 64 audio channels via camera network streams
Integrated in MOBOTIX HUB as a decentralized recording and display device
Embedded Linux, Intel Skylake i5-6500, 8 GB DDR4
notes: The datasheet gives up to 64 IP channels, with a maximum of 24 on the integrated PoE ports and up to 40 more through an external switch.
The product page states that a further 48 ONVIF cameras can be added; the datasheet gives 40.
The product page lists RAID 0/1/2/5/10; the datasheet lists RAID 0/1/5/10.
The datasheet specification table gives 1 x HDMI and 1 x DisplayPort for local display; its rear-panel description lists two HDMI connectors (HDMI 2, HDMI 3).
incoming_mbps is the stated peak IPCAM throughput; the stated average is 480 Mbps.
